mentions.name: Codimix
mentions.description: Codimix is a platform where developers network by building together. Users join timed coding events scheduled at different hours so developers worldwide can participate, meet other developers, and collaborate in teams on small projects over a few hours.
mentions.problem: Developers lack a natural way to get to know each other; the best way to know someone is to work with them on something.
mentions.audience: Developers worldwide who want to network by building together through timed coding events.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Codimix - Build Connections, One Commit at a Time

We launched Codimix - a platform where developers network by building together.
